title: Don’t waste your money
text: I feel bad that someone wasted their money gifting this to me. For $16 you will receive 16 teabags of variable  quality (same as you can get at the grocery store for so much less money.)  They say the selections are personalized based on a questionnaire you submit, but each month I have received some teas that I have absolutely no desire to even taste.  I was looking forward to my subscription ending because what am I going to do with all this tea I don’t want? only to realize they auto-renew with no heads-up until you see the charge on your credit card.
label: negative
